question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., "Thyriod."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Thyroid."**
 
• "Thyroid" means 'a gland (= an organ) in the front of the neck that is involved in controlling the way the body develops and works.' (अवटुग्रन्थि; गर्दन के सामने एक ग्रंथि (= एक अंग) जो शरीर के विकास और काम करने के तरीके को नियंत्रित करने में शामिल है)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *My doctor prescribed medication to regulate my **thyroid **gland.*
 
 
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.​
